scope_note: Source-dated independent auditor statements reproduced from original publicly hosted documents; Katoptron did not independently audit agency systems or confirm current settings.

reports.report_title: Independent audit of Shakopee Police Department ALPR system
reports.author: Lynn Lembcke Consulting

findings.statement: The report says Shakopee implemented Flock ALPRs in June 2025 and describes six permanent Flock ALPR locations during its audit. It does not establish how many cameras operate today.
The auditor reported a 30-day retention setting for Flock ALPR data and a 60-day setting for Axon squad ALPR data during the audited period. This does not establish current settings.
The report describes role-restricted access and audit trails, and says officers were required to record reasons and case numbers when accessing ALPR data during the audit.
The auditor recorded no discrepancies noted in the examined statutory categories. This describes the auditor's findings for the audited period, not an independent Katoptron compliance certification.

reports.report_title: Stillwater Police Department 2026 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor reported 17 stationary Flock ALPR units at the time of its September 2026 audit. This is an auditor-attributed historical count, not a current installation inventory or individual camera map.

The auditor reported a manufacturer-default 30-day Flock data retention period and said the Flock Vehicle Reads report confirmed it during the audit. This does not establish subsequent agency settings.

The auditor reported that Stillwater's Flock console showed no out-of-state sharing in its Shared Network section at the time of the audit. That is a time-limited observation of one interface, not proof no external agency ever accessed data.

reports.report_title: Hennepin County Sheriff's Office 2025 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The independent auditor reported four active stationary Flock ALPR units within Hennepin County in its October 2025 report. The count is historical, not a present-day equipment inventory.
The auditor reported a default Flock 30-day data retention period, confirmed by a Flock Vehicle Reads report reviewed during the audit period. This does not establish current agency settings.
The auditor described interagency ALPR data requests as reviewed through agency command. The report does not identify all current recipients or establish an ongoing shared-network permission list.

reports.report_title: Richfield Police Department 2026 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: In the May 2026 summary, the independent auditor reported eight stationary Flock ALPR units at Richfield Police Department during the period reviewed. This is a historical auditor-attributed system count, not a current inventory or a list of camera positions.

The auditor reported the Flock system's manufacturer-default 30-day retention setting and said that a Flock Vehicle Reads report confirmed the setting during the review. This does not prove the agency's settings today.

The auditor reported that interagency requests were logged in the Flock system by agency and justification and that a March 2026 sample showed reasons for sharing. This is a sampled historical finding, not a complete or current sharing-partner network.

reports.report_title: Woodbury Public Safety 2026 ALPR Audit (Flock System) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The February 2026 independent audit reported 17 active stationary Flock ALPR units and no mobile Flock units for Woodbury Public Safety at the time examined. These figures do not establish present deployment or camera coordinates.

The auditor reported the Flock system's 30-day manufacturer-default retention setting, confirmed through a Flock Vehicle Reads report at the time of the audit. No later retention configuration is verified here.

The report describes interagency data requests recorded by agency name, requesting party and case number, and an audit sample with stated justifications. It does not identify standing shared-network permissions or current recipient agencies.

reports.report_title: Brooklyn Center Police Department 2025 ALPR Audit (Flock) Executive Summary
reports.author: Minnesota Security Consortium (MNSec)

findings.statement: The 2025 report concerning Brooklyn Center's Flock ALPR system stated that the department had nine active stationary ALPR units and no Flock mobile units at the time of review. The statement does not establish current inventory, geolocations or individual manufacturer labels.

The auditor reported the Flock system's default 30-day retention period and stated that it was checked against a Flock Vehicle Reads report. This historical report does not verify later retention settings.

The auditor described interagency requests documented by agency, requesting party and case number through a records manager. The report does not provide a comprehensive or current list of data-sharing partners.
